meta.label: Demo data
meta.warning: All observations and numeric inputs are fictional or simulated for prototype evaluation. No live research, purchases or market counts are implied.

opportunities.title: Acquisition financing readiness workspace
opportunities.short: A deal-ready financing packet for sub-$5M acquisitions.
opportunities.operator: Independent sponsor, searcher or M&A advisor assembling lender-ready deal materials
opportunities.buyer: Independent sponsors and search-fund acquisition teams
opportunities.payer: Acquirer or sponsor leading an active transaction
opportunities.workaround: Email threads, advisor spreadsheets, lender checklists and outside diligence help
opportunities.trigger: LOI accepted, financing clock starts, lender asks for missing package items
opportunities.alternatives: DIY spreadsheets; deal advisors; lender portals; existing virtual data rooms
opportunities.downside: High-touch services may be hard to standardize; lenders may prefer their own documentation workflows.
opportunities.wouldChange: Verified paid pilots from acquirers and repeatable lender submission requirements across three lender channels.

experiment.threshold: 2 paid $500+ diagnostic pilots from 12 qualified acquisition teams

opportunities.title: Managed FinOps close & cash-visibility service
opportunities.short: Close cadence, cash controls and management reporting for growing operators.
opportunities.operator: Controller or fractional finance operator reconciling books and reporting cash
opportunities.payer: Owner, CFO or COO accountable for reporting and liquidity
opportunities.workaround: Bookkeeper plus disconnected spreadsheets, bank downloads and monthly consultant catch-ups
opportunities.trigger: Second location opens, lender covenant arrives, or monthly reporting slips
opportunities.alternatives: In-house controller; outsourced bookkeeping; fractional CFO; ERP dashboards
opportunities.downside: Existing providers could bundle reporting; service margins may compress with highly customized onboarding.
opportunities.wouldChange: Signed annual agreements from two target firms, measured hours saved and proof of repeatable gross margin.

experiment.threshold: 2 signed 60-day paid pilots at $1,500+ / month from 15 calls
experiment.stop: No paid pilot after 15 qualified buyer meetings

opportunities.title: Partner operations API for funding brokers
opportunities.short: Automate referral intake, lender routing and partner-status visibility.
opportunities.operator: Broker operations lead managing submissions, status updates and partner attribution
opportunities.buyer: Independent funding brokerages and embedded referral networks
opportunities.payer: Brokerage principal or platform operator — unverified willingness to pay
opportunities.workaround: CRM custom fields, spreadsheets, forms, group chats and manual follow-up
opportunities.trigger: New referral program, channel expansion or increased document-chase volume
opportunities.alternatives: HubSpot; Airtable; proprietary broker CRM; broker portal; manual coordinator
opportunities.downside: High search activity may reflect free-tool shoppers; brokers may resist paying for a standalone layer.
opportunities.wouldChange: Three brokerage owners agreeing to a priced pilot or a signed workflow commitment; verify budget owner.

experiment.threshold: 3 signed $250+ / month pilot commitments from 15 brokerage owners
